        Recently analyzed

          🧮 Risk plan not set

          Most picks fail — even good-looking ones. What keeps an early-entry strategy alive is size. Enter the money you've set aside for meme coins and every coin card shows the most that coin can justify (smaller for brand-new launches, capped by what the pool lets you sell). A ceiling for risk control — never a suggestion to buy.

          📶 Data sources

          ⚡ Turbo mode off — not required

          Works without this. But the free public Solana RPC often refuses holder lookups, so the extension falls back to RugCheck (full scans only). A free Helius key (helius.dev → API Keys) makes holder checks reliable on every scan, scans ~3× more launches per sweep, and adds the metadata-mutability check.

          𝕏 Monitor off

          Live X search per coin works with no setup. To also show automated recent-post counts, paste an X (Twitter) API v2 Bearer token (developer.x.com). Optional — hype is context, never proof.
